en: A multi-view color postcard. The front shows five images arranged on an orange background: four photos of ornate ceramic vases and pitchers, and in the center a photograph of a decorated fountain set in an urban square with historic stone buildings and traffic in the background. Below the collage, the caption "PÉCS" is printed. The reverse side is a standard divided back with address lines, stamp boxes, price information and publisher details printed in Hungarian.
